purpose: Define the controlled structural/site-interface inputs, load cases, reaction outputs and promotion gates required before VX4800 can receive project-specific structural approval without inventing loads before physical and kinetic inputs are controlled.

controlledBaseline.primarySupport: site structure via engineered interface zones
controlledBaseline.manufacturingGeometryAuthority: external controlled VX4800 Product Release / released manufacturing package

supportBoundary.validPrimarySupport: verified building structure or purpose-designed structural support system approved for the project loads

requiredProductInputs.quantity: complete rotating assembly mass including carrier, rotating hardware and 240 suspended assemblies
requiredProductInputs.sourceDependency: kinetic first article / controlled mass measurement

requiredProductInputs.quantity: complete fixture and rotating-assembly centre of gravity required by structural and kinetic calculations
normal acceleration, steady rotation and controlled deceleration reactions transferred from kinetic assembly into fixed canopy
fault-stop / abnormal-motion reactions transferred into fixed canopy
approved residual imbalance and production/replacement mass-variation reactions
requiredProductInputs.sourceDependency: released balance/trim and kinetic load analysis

requiredProductInputs.quantity: load case for engagement of independent secondary carrier retention and any other structural secondary retention
temporary loads and restraint conditions created by installation, service, locking or maintenance procedures

requiredSiteInputs.purpose: determine jurisdiction, design basis and environmental/site actions
identify actual building structure and material supporting the interface
verify member sizes, geometry, reinforcement and allowable interface zones
confirm built condition, obstructions, tolerances and access
separate decorative ceiling coordination from structural support
support exact anchor/support design after substrate is known
confirm governing code, load combinations, importance/reliability and project requirements

requiredLoadCases.description: complete installed dead load using controlled measured mass
released normal kinetic operating reactions combined with gravity
released fault/abnormal stop reaction case where structurally relevant
approved residual imbalance / production mass-variation case
credible secondary-retention engagement/failure scenario transferred to fixed structure
installation/hoisting/temporary restraint loads applicable to released method

reactionOutputs.rule: No interface reaction value may be released until controlled product inputs, kinetic load cases, site geometry and the engineer-approved structural model are available.

analysisRequirements: Use the released manufacturing structural interfaces, not coordination geometry, for final connection analysis.
Check fixed canopy structural frame strength, stiffness and local connection behavior under approved load combinations.
Check global and local deflection against alignment, bearing, drive, service-panel and architectural tolerances established by released engineering requirements.
Check interface-zone load distribution without assuming equal 1/8 sharing unless demonstrated by structural stiffness/modeling.
Check torsional and eccentric reactions produced by actual centre of gravity and kinetic load cases.
Check secondary-retention load path independently from the primary load path where required by its architecture.
Check site structural member capacity and local effects using the actual project structure.
Design anchors/bolts/welds/support steel only after substrate, geometry, material properties, edge distances and reinforcement/member details are verified.
Document installation tolerances and any leveling/alignment provisions that affect load distribution.
Perform an evidence-impact review when product mass, kinetic architecture, interface geometry, site structure or anchor/support design changes.
forbiddenAssumptions: Do not calculate total load from decorative material density or Blender/coordination geometry in place of controlled physical mass.
Do not assume the eight interface zones share reactions equally.
Do not select anchors from a catalog before actual substrate and project reaction/load combination are known.
Do not use false-ceiling framing, decorative canopy skin, MEP supports or electrical services as primary structural support unless separately engineered and explicitly released for that purpose.
Do not treat repository package validation as structural approval.
Do not use nominal operating rpm alone to invent dynamic amplification or stopping loads.
Do not inherit a structural release across a changed site, material tier, kinetic mechanism, total mass or interface configuration without impact review.
deliverablesRequiredForStructuralRelease: controlled product input sheet with measured masses and centre of gravity
site structural survey and structural drawing references
project design criteria / governing structural basis
per-interface reaction schedule for governing load combinations
dependencies: rotating-carrier engineering track for released kinetic reactions
